MD-S036-R0012.prior_defect: The finding's own remedy table names the defect precisely: the old basis pointed at the ReplayMode (PUBLICATION_EXACT/AS_KNOWN) guard, a domain distinct from the eod_runs.request_mode vocabulary this predicate actually governs.
MD-S036-R0012.guard: MarketDataStageInput::ALLOWED_REQUEST_MODES is the real allowlist; MarketDataPipelineService::assertAllowedRequestMode() is the real enforcement boundary (throws REQUEST_MODE_INVALID for any mode outside it). RequestModeVocabularyTest already invoked this real method behaviourally, but its dataProvider for the positive test derives its cases from ALLOWED_REQUEST_MODES itself -- confirmed live: removing replay_verify from the array did not fail the guard, it silently shrank the dataProvider by one case (16/16 green instead of a failure naming replay_verify). A new, independent test was added, test_replay_verify_specifically_is_an_accepted_request_mode, asserting the literal string 'replay_verify' against the real method -- not a value read from the array under test.
MD-S036-R0012.probe: Removed replay_verify from ALLOWED_REQUEST_MODES: the new test turned red with InvalidArgumentException REQUEST_MODE_INVALID naming exactly the removed mode (17 tests, 1 error). Byte-restored from a pre-mutation copy, sha256 confirmed identical (9738870e2df0626ca1917782540f812ecc1ea432d69d9c7b187c51e6f0279ddd before and after), control re-run green (17/17, 22 assertions).

MD-S050-R0036.rule: A result carrying no mode is not a publication-replay result by default. It is unclassified, and an unclassified result may not be cited as either (Replay_Verification_Contract_LOCKED.md lines 70-71).
MD-S050-R0036.prior_defect: The old basis concerned command invocation (ReplayModeContractTest / OpsCommandSurfaceTest), while this predicate concerns a stored, already-unmoded result -- the read side of the rule, for a corpus row that predates MD-S050-R0035's write-time mandate.
MD-S050-R0036.guard: B18ReplayEvidenceSelfExplanationTest::test_an_unmoded_result_is_not_admitted_as_citable_evidence forces replay_mode=null onto a real exported metric row and asserts the real (unmocked) MarketDataEvidenceExportService::exportReplayEvidence marks the pack ADMITTED_INCOMPLETE, reason EVIDENCE_ADMISSION_INCOMPLETE, naming replay_mode_invalid_or_historical_unclassified among missing_sections. test_every_exported_pack_requires_and_carries_the_mode_that_produced_it is the positive control: a correctly-moded PUBLICATION_EXACT or AS_KNOWN result is independently proven ADMITTED_COMPLETE, so the guard is not merely refusing every export.
MD-S050-R0036.probe: Removed the else-branch in MarketDataEvidenceExportService.php that appends replay_mode_invalid_or_historical_unclassified to missing_sections when the mode is neither PUBLICATION_EXACT nor AS_KNOWN. The discriminating test turned red on exactly that assertion ("Failed asserting that an array contains 'replay_mode_invalid_or_historical_unclassified'"). Byte-restored, sha256 confirmed identical (3aeee9762b391a3fe9d017c34fd624942322de6ef8922b09d4454fb58ae8d21d before and after), control re-run green (14/14, 143 assertions).

MD-S003-R0021.rule: Later master, event, status, calendar, config, formula, and factor revisions are invisible before their recorded/known times (Historical_Replay_and_Data_Quality_Backtest.md lines 43-46).
MD-S003-R0021.prior_defect: The finding's own remedy table names the defect precisely: 'The positive guard only checks that the mapped guard methods exist.' test_every_later_revision_kind_is_bound_to_an_executing_guard performs exactly that -- a string search for 'function <name>(' in a file -- which proves nothing about whether the method's body actually enforces the cutoff.
MD-S003-R0021.guard: Rebound to test_a_later_cutoff_exposes_later_revisions_without_rewriting_the_earlier_snapshot, a behavioural guard using real repositories and real seeded DB rows (no mocks), distinguished only by recorded_at, exercising all seven contract-named roots in one real AsKnownReplaySnapshotService::capture() call: an early cutoff sees only early-recorded rows for each root; a later cutoff exposes the later-recorded rows for each root; re-running the early cutoff after the later capture returns a byte-identical snapshot_hash; and no bound-input row is created or mutated by either capture (boundRowCounts unchanged).

MD-S003-R0021.negative_probe: test_an_incomplete_historical_config_snapshot_is_refused_instead_of_using_live_config uses a real repository and a real corrupted DB row (resolved_config_json set to '{}'), not a mock. Removing the refusal and substituting a live-config fallback turned this test red (an ErrorException on the now-undefined resolved_config key, rather than a silent live-config success). Byte-restored, sha256 identical, control green.

MD-S005-R0096.rule: Fixtures must prove: as-known replay excludes later revisions (Audit_Hash_and_Reproducibility_Contract_LOCKED.md line 154, item 6).
MD-S005-R0096.prior_defect: Same method-existence defect the finding names for MD-S003-R0021; this predicate is the fixture-proof framing of the identical underlying rule, reviewed independently rather than assumed proven merely because it shares a guard with R0021.
MD-S005-R0096.guard: Same guard pair as MD-S003-R0021 -- test_a_later_cutoff_exposes_later_revisions_without_rewriting_the_earlier_snapshot (positive) and test_an_incomplete_historical_config_snapshot_is_refused_instead_of_using_live_config (negative) -- reviewed and confirmed independently to satisfy this predicate's own wording rather than bulk-promoted alongside R0021.
MD-S005-R0096.probes: Identical seven-root probe set as MD-S003-R0021 (see above); each independently proves that as-known replay excludes later revisions for its own root, not merely that R0021's wording is satisfied.
